question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH sales_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS BIGINT) AS businessentityid,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS order_year,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
  GROUP BY salespersonid, order_year
),
quota_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    BusinessEntityID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS quota_year,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS total_quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, quota_year
)
SELECT 
  s.businessentityid,
  s.order_year AS year,
  ROUND(s.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
  ROUND(q.total_quota, 2) AS total_quota,
  ROUND(s.total_sales - q.total_quota, 2) AS difference
FROM sales_totals s
LEFT JOIN quota_totals q ON s.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND s.order_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY s.businessentityid, s.order_year

  SELECT

    SUM(SalesQuota) AS total_quota

  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, quota_year
)

  s.businessentityid,
  s.order_year AS year,
  ROUND(s.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
  ROUND(q.total_quota, 2) AS total_quota,
  ROUND(s.total_sales - q.total_quota, 2) AS difference
FROM sales_totals s
